headings.text: JLCCNC Passes Rigorous Three-Year BSI Recertification for ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27701
Why BSI Recertification Matters: Raising the Bar on Security
What This Means for Engineers, Startups, and Enterprise Buyers

meta_description: JLC Technology Group passes BSI's rigorous 3-year recertification for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 & 27701:2019, safeguarding customer IP, Gerber files, and data privacy.
monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCCNC Passes Rigorous Three-Year BSI Recertification for ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27701 JLCCNC Passes Rigorous Three-Year BSI Recertification for ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27701 Press Release Nov 27, 2026 Table of Contents Why BSI Recertification Matters: Raising the Bar on Security What This Means for Engineers, Startups, and Enterprise Buyers A Multi-Layered Global Compliance Ecosystem About JLC Technology Group JLC Technology Group has successfully passed the comprehensive three-year recertification audit for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Information Security Management System) and ISO/IEC 27701:2019 (Privacy Information Management System), conducted by the British Standards Institution (BSI) . Having first achieved these certifications in 2023 and maintained them through annual surveillance audits for four consecutive years, JLC Technology Group has now cleared the rigorous triennial reassessment—reaffirming its enterprise-grade commitment to data security and global privacy compliance. Why BSI Recertification Matters: Raising the Bar on Security Unlike routine annual check-ins, an ISO recertification audit occurs every three years and requires a full, top-to-bottom re-evaluation of an organization’s entire security infrastructure. For this milestone, JLC Technology Group underwent auditing by BSI —the world’s first national standards body and a founding member of ISO, widely recognized for its exceptionally stringent auditing criteria. Meeting BSI’s strict benchmarks across both standards demonstrates that JLC Technology Group’s security controls are not merely static policies, but deeply embedded, continuously verified operational practices: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Validates end-to-end risk management across information assets, access control, physical security, system operations, and supplier governance—ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive technical data. ISO/IEC 27701:2019: Extends the security framework to strict privacy governance, establishing a globally recognized baseline for handling Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and supporting compliance with international data protection regulations such as GDPR. The scope of both certifications spans JLC Technology Group’s core digital manufacturing platforms—including JLCCNC , JLCPCB , JLC3DP , and JLCMC . What This Means for Engineers, Startups, and Enterprise Buyers For hardware engineers, product designers, and procurement teams, uploading proprietary Gerber files, BOMs, or 3D CAD models to an external manufacturing partner requires absolute trust. Passing BSI’s dual recertification translates directly into tangible protection for customers: Safeguarding Intellectual Property (IP): Strict access controls and isolated data environments minimize the risk of design leaks, unauthorized access, or IP theft throughout the prototyping and production lifecycle. Streamlining Enterprise Vendor Onboarding: For corporate buyers and regulated industries, working with a BSI-certified manufacturer simplifies supply chain risk assessments and fulfills strict internal vendor compliance mandates. End-to-End Privacy Assurance: From account registration to global logistics, customer personal and corporate data is processed under internationally audited privacy controls. A Multi-Layered Global Compliance Ecosystem These renewed ISO certifications build upon JLC Technology Group’s existing portfolio of international security credentials, including PCI DSS compliance and SOC 2 attestation. Together, they form a defense-in-depth security architecture that supports reliable, compliant electronics and mechanical manufacturing for customers worldwide. The updated ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27701:2019 certificates are available for review and download in the Certifications section of the JLCPCB website. About JLC Technology Group Founded in 2006, JLC Technology Group provides integrated electronics and mechanical manufacturing services to more than 9.5 million customers across over 180 countries and regions. Its ecosystem includes EasyEDA for PCB design, JLCPCB for PCB fabrication and assembly, JLC3DP for additive manufacturing, JLCCNC for CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication, and JLCMC for mechanical components—enabling customers to turn ideas into reality — from prototype to production.
